# Methods

The relationship between the variables is given by the inline equation
$E = mc^2$, which relates energy and mass.

More formally, the general form is expressed as:

$$
\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\, dx = F(b) - F(a)
$$

This approach builds on established techniques in the field [@jordan2015machine].
Further supporting evidence is discussed in @akmalia2025expression.

> "The best way to predict the future is to invent it." This principle
> guides the overall approach taken here.
